mapper.select: SELECT fnd02_fund_info_id AS fund_info_id , CAST(fnd02_work_date AS date) AS work_date , fnd02_fund_nm AS fund_name , fnd02_fund_full_nm AS fund_full_name , fnd02_kofia_fund_cd AS kofia_fund_code , fnd02_ksd_fund_cd AS ksd_fund_code , fnd02_ksd_item_cd AS ksd_item_code , f_cdnm('IcamTrustCode', fnd02_kofia_trust_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_trust_name , f_cdnm('IcamFundType', fnd02_kofia_fund_type_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_fund_type_name , f_cdnm('IcamPublicCode', fnd02_kofia_public_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_public_name , f_cdnm('IcamParentCode', fnd02_kofia_parent_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_parent_name , f_cdnm('IcamClassType', fnd02_kofia_class_type_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_class_type_name , f_cdnm('IcamFundUnitCode', fnd02_kofia_fund_unit_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_fund_unit_name , f_cdnm('IcamCharClassCode', fnd02_kofia_char_class_cd, fnd01_company_id, fnd02_work_date) AS kofia_char_class_name , fnd02_org_code_nm AS org_code_name , fnd02_operator1 AS operator1 , fnd02_operator2 AS operator2 , fnd02_cur AS cur , fnd02_seolj_aek AS seolj_aek , fnd02_sunjasan_aek AS sunjasan_aek , std_price AS std_price , fnd02_next_close_date AS next_close_date , fnd02_next_fee_date AS next_fee_date , fnd02_end_expect_date AS end_expect_date , ( SELECT fnd03_consignment_nm FROM fnd03_consignment WHERE fnd03_consignment_cd = fnd02_consignment_cd AND fnd03_company_id = fnd01_company_id ) AS consignment_name , ( SELECT fnd09_trust_bank_nm FROM fnd09_trust_bank WHERE fnd09_trust_bank_cd = fnd02_trust_bank_cd AND fnd09_company_id = fnd01_company_id ) AS trust_bank_name , ( SELECT fnd06_office_work_nm FROM fnd06_office_work WHERE fnd06_office_work_cd = fnd02_office_work_cd AND fnd06_company_id = fnd01_company_id ) AS office_work_name , fnd02_management_rate AS management_rate , fnd02_sales_rate AS sales_rate , fnd02_consignment_rate AS consignment_rate , fnd02_office_work_rate AS office_work_rate FROM fnd02_fund_info INNER JOIN fnd01_fund_code ON fnd01_fund_code_id = fnd02_fund_code_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT icam06_std_date std_date , icam06_std_price std_price FROM icam06_fund_book INNER JOIN sys01_company ON ( sys01_icam_company_cd = icam06_icam_company_cd AND sys01_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) WHERE icam06_fund_cd = #{c.fundCode} UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT to_date(ifi32_std_date,'yyyymmdd') std_date , ifi32_price std_price FROM ifi32_fund_price INNER JOIN ifi29_am_corp_mapping ON ( ifi29_if_cd = ifi32_if_cd AND ifi29_am_corp_cd = ifi32_am_corp_cd AND ifi29_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) WHERE ifi32_if_cd IN ('SFTP_SHFP_01','SFTP_KBFP_01') AND ifi32_fund_cd = #{c.fundCode} AND ifi32_cur_cd = 'KRW' ) prc ON std_date = fnd02_work_date WHERE fnd01_fund_cd = #{c.fundCode} AND fnd01_company_id = #{c.companyId} ORDER BY fnd02_work_date DESC LIMIT #{c.limit} OFFSET #{c.offset}
